_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. calendly.com's marketing site declares a --color-*/--text-ui-*/--radius-ui-* design-token layer in its Astro stylesheets and paints it light with .dark islands; the public booking pages are a second application declaring a booking-kit token layer (--coreColor*/--primary-color*/--fontFamily* plus the same --color-* names) and painting light. Declared variables become var leaves (booking variables carry resolve: bookingLight); the painted booking blues and measured geometry are measured leaves from raw/components-computed.json.
